offence_note: First degree murder of a child (historical)
sentence_quote: I sentence you to life imprisonment without eligibility for parole until you have served 25 years of that sentence.
note: Victim was a child; weapons prohibition 10 years.

offence_note: Break and enter stealing firearms; trafficking a firearm to undercover officer
sentence_quote: I will be sentencing you to a further sentence of four years and 230 days, taking into consideration the credit of 135 days, and so the record would reflect a five‑year sentence with respect to the offences.
note: Global sentence reduced from 5.5 to 5 years for Charter breach; lifetime weapons prohibition.

offence_note: Manslaughter after beating, kidnapping and running over victim
co_offenders: Gazeley and Brunt: 7 years each (earlier sentences, not under appeal)
sentence_quote: I would allow the appeal to the extent of reducing the sentence by six months.
note: Majority (Donald, Saunders) reduced by six months; Lowry dissented in part. Figures derived: 9y less 46 months credit.

sentence_quote: The appellant was convicted of dangerous driving and sentenced to 15 months imprisonment and a three-year driving prohibition.

offence_note: Dangerous offender designation; offences not shown
note: SCC upholds order for new sentencing hearing; dangerous offender finding not reinstated.

sentence_quote: I cannot say that the learned trial judge erred when he imposed a custodial sentence of 15 months.
note: Summary conviction appeal; conviction and sentence appeals dismissed; probation length not shown.

offence_note: Eight municipal temporary sign by-law infractions by a company
sentence_quote: The trial judge imposed a sentence of a $500 fine for each of the eight convictions, plus costs of $122.50 and a victim surcharge of $75 each, totalling $5,580.00.
note: Corporate offender; mitigating factor was no further tickets since 2017; costs excluded from fine.

offence_note: Possessing handguns with altered serial numbers
sentence_quote: To repeat, the sentence I am imposing is the one contained in Schedule A, including the proposed ancillary orders, which are found at the bottom of page 3 of Schedule A.
note: One-year conditional sentence with 9pm-6am curfew; s.110 order for 10 years.

offence_note: Armed robbery, assaults, breaches of probation
sentence_quote: I would reduce the total sentence to twenty-one months imprisonment, less 152 days to account for time served by Ms. Martin while on remand.
note: Crown appeal allowed; total raised from 15 to 21 months (trial judge's concurrent approach was error).

sentence_quote: leave to appeal is granted, the appeal is allowed and the sentence is reduced to six months less a day.
note: Reduced from six months to avoid immigration consequences.

offence_note: Manslaughter substituted for second degree murder
sentence_quote: impose a sentence of time served, which we consider the functional equivalent of a sentence of imprisonment of 7 years
note: Life with 14 years replaced by time served, about 7 years; no remaining jail to serve.
